items.title: Benny Waters interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995
items.q: Benny Carter made two, and a white arranger named Ken McComa made one, and all the rest I made.

ctx.x: Black Swan Records? He was with Black Swan?

No, I don’t know if it was Black — I don’t know the name of the record right now, see. I don’t know if it was Okeh, Black Swan or Emerson or what. In that category, yes. But that was my first record. But the next record I made it was with this band that I worked so long at Small’s Paradise. That was on Victor Records. And at that session we had Benny Carter, we had Jimmy Harrison, we had Jabbo Smith, we had Sidney DeParis and this bass player I’m telling you about. And at that session I made all the arrangements…
